lastResponse.text: Great question. Safest assumption: anyone on that provider’s intake or care team who handles requests may see the message. If you want extra privacy, we can keep it minimal: “following up on voicemail, can meals start next week, low-sodium needed,” with no diagnosis or extra personal details. We can also use just first name or initials. If you’d rather, I can give you a short script so you send it directly.
